The trophy requirements are relatively lenient. There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay function. The biggest overall requirement is finishing the [100% Completion Checklist](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-100-completion-checklist-guide/), but this doesn’t require everything. It’s closer to 60% true completion, with most side quests not being required, and collectibles only partially required. You only need to scan 200 of 277 Base Model Vehicles and study 100 of 255 Animals by looking at them through the binoculars. The story is divided into 5 Chapters and takes around 60-80 hours. After the story you continue in free-roam and everything needed for the 100% Checklist is still accessible. The gold medals for shooting ranges and racing challenges aren’t too difficult and you only need 70 of 80 Challenges, allowing to skip the hardest ones. Play the game however you like, do as much side content as you want and clean up the rest after the story. ### Step 1: Finish Story + Complete Optional Missions, Scan Vehicles & Animals [60-80 Hours] Just finish the story and enjoy the game. The 100% Checklist isn’t viewable until after the story, but any progress you make during the story will already count toward it. Feel free to work on any side content you find or do it all after the story. There are no mission gold medals this time, so you don’t need to watch out for hidden objectives. **1 Potentially Missable Trophy:** * [**Positive Mental Attitude**](#positive-mental-attitude) (meditate at every spot across Leonida): there is 1 missable Meditation during Chapter 1 at Jason’s house. For 100% Completion you need to scan any 200 of the 277 base model vehicles. If you start early you will get it done naturally throughout the story. Also scan boats and aircraft. * **Study Animals** – study any new animals you come across using the binoculars. Hold to select binoculars from weapon wheel, zoom in with and hold to study. For 100% Completion you need to study any 100 of 255 animals. Every breed of dog and cat counts separately too. Unlike Red Dead Redemption 2, you don’t need to hunt and skin the animals, just studying any 100 of them is enough. * **UI Notifications** – turn on all UI settings for progress & collectible notifications. This is helpful to keep track of new discoveries and how your actions affect your criminal profile. **Note regarding missable content (this doesn’t affect trophies):** There is a bunch of missable content, but it doesn’t impact trophies or 100% completion. This doesn’t impact any trophies or 100% requirements as you gradually unlock new fences. They fail after a while but they are not relevant for trophies. If you do all quests as they appear you won’t have to worry about it. * Open world Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story. You don’t have to worry about these. * Criminal Profile only affects how police treat you. The lower your profile, the higher the chance they shoot at you on sight. You can do all content with a violent profile. However, the Irredeemable profile is permanent and should be avoided because cops will be more aggressive. * The relationship status of Jason/Lucia doesn’t matter for trophies. *In summary: just keep a look out for the Chapter 1 meditation and don’t worry about anything else.* **» [GTA 6 Full Walkthrough – All Missions](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-full-walkthrough-all-missions/)** ### Step 2: 100% Completion Checklist & 70 of 80 Challenges [100 Hours] After the story you are returned to the open world and unlock the 100% Completion Checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Collecting at least 3 complete sets is required for the trophy/achievement **Don’t Touch My Deck**, whereas collecting at least 15 complete sets is required for the **[100% Completion Checklist](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-100-completion-checklist-guide/)**and trophy/achievement **A Long Road**. Collectible Cards are found all throughout the game world, inside and outside buildings. Cards inside buildings are typically found on surfaces or stuck to walls, whereas cards found outside buildings are typically found in yellow phone boxes on walls or tool boxes on surfaces. Unlike in Red Dead Redemption 2, cards cannot be farmed by purchasing items, they can only be obtained by picking them up, so there is a finite number of cards. Completing 15 sets requires picking up at minimum 372 out of 480 unique cards depending on which sets you complete, as different sets have different amounts of cards available. After card is obtained it can then be sold at any of the Pawn Shops present in the game, for differing values depending on the “rarity” of the card, ranging from $20 to upwards of $1000+. Selling cards doesn’t remove them from your Collections list, so you don’t need to purposely keep found cards if you would rather sell them for money before a set is complete. Cards within a set can have different color versions of the same card (Bronze/Silver/Gold, Red/Blue/Purple). Collecting each color version counts as a unique card for the completion of the set. Some cards can be found multiple times in different locations, but this does not count multiple times toward set completion, it only gives a duplicate of the same card that you can sell again. **All 18 Collectible Card Sets:** 1. https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/gr.meat: We're giving away more prizes to players who have finished the Logitech G PRO Pass! ## Overview To get the Paradise Lost Trophy, you must complete Chapter 1 of the story, the trophy is unmissable with natural progression. **Important to note:** During Chapter 1, there are a few things that you must make sure of before making it to Chapter 2 as there will be a point of no return at the end of the chapter. **Missable:** Make sure that you are taking part in the meditation with Lucia in Chapter 1 at Jason's place, she will talk about wanting to clear her head, make sure that you join her for this Meditation spot. There is also the opportunity to launch all three games on the JoySystem when playing it as part of the story with Cal at Jason's place, 2 games launch automatically, but launching the third on the console has to be done manually. If you don't do this here, you will have to launch the game later on, I will remind you of this again in Chapter 3. Still need help with other trophies? Check out the main page: ## Paradise Lost Trophy Progress all the way through Chapter 1, until you are walking into the hospital as Lucia. Once you make it to the hospital, head inside and go left and up the stairs to the first floor. Once you make it to the next Reception desk, head through the white double doors at the back. Through here, talk with one of the nurses and ask for "John Doe", she will direct you to the room where Jason is. After the cutscene, Lucia will take Jason out of the room in a wheelchair, you will be stopped by one of the nurses, but you need to keep an eye on the guy coming through the white double doors, be ready to take him out as Jason. (He will remain in the wheelchair) Once he is dealt with, Lucia will not stop walking so be ready for the upcoming enemies and take these out also, she will wheel Jason into an elevator and you will take this together. After taking the elevator, Lucia will keep walking again, you will have to be quick in taking out the enemies along the way. Upcoming, you will get jumped by an enemy and will have to defend yourself as Lucia. After the cutscene, Lucia will be dragging Jason, and you will need to take out the enemies through the glass as Jason to protect both he and Lucia. Keep progressing until Jason is back in the wheelchair and you have to take on more enemies throughout the hospital. Keep progressing until you switch back to Lucia and start shooting at all the enemies in the darker hospital area, you will need to defend Jason here. Keep going until you make it into the colourful corridor area, here, be careful not to shoot innocent civilians, only take on the enemies. Keep progressing through the hospital remembering not to shoot the innocent. After the next short cutscene, Lucia and Jason will split up, Lucia will go to find a ride out of there, meanwhile Jason is still in the wheelchair. He will get jumped by an enemy, you will have to defend yourself here. Keep doing so until Lucia brings the ride to escape. The next segment will be a chase scene, where you are shooting the enemies chasing you as Jason from the back of the Ambulance truck. The chase sequence is over once you make it over the railway and the oncoming train stops the enemies from chasing you further. There will be many cutscenes upcoming so keep on enjoying the story, you will then wake up as Jason in a Motel room, Lucia will come over and as her, you will both be looking through the contents of the case you have. Once you have looked over everything, you will have control of Lucia in the Motel room, and here is where the Paradise Lost Trophy will pop, signifying the completion of Chapter 1.

This walkthrough will guide you through all objectives of the **Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs** main quest. - **Starting Location:** Vice City/Ocean Beach Banks - **Chapter:** Chapter 3 - **Quest Giver:** Yasmani - **Requirement:** Complete Chapter 3 “Boobie Time“ - **Can Be Started By:** Lucia/Jason - **Reward:** Snap Gun (unlock doors without triggering alarms) + Yasmani pickup from Garage drop-offs + $20,000 from objective items + extra dependent on how much you steal from each location - **Quest Description:** Yasmani is after items that are stored in safes at these banks. **Objectives:** 1. Hit Casa de Empeno 2. Hit Richardson Jewelry 3. Hit Donovan Banks & Co. ## Starting Location: Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs After completing “Boobie Time” Yasmani will contact you about some jobs robbing specific jewelry stores to obtain specific items he wants. You can do these in whichever order that you want, but it is recommended to deliver the jewelry to Yasmani after doing the first one because he will then give you the **Snap Gun** which allows you to open doors without triggering alarms, which makes the other robberies much easier as police will take longer to arrive. ## Hit Casa De Empeno “Yasmani is after a buffalo skull chain that’s stored in a safe here.” This jewelry store is recommended to be done first, because there isn’t a back door that you can enter with the Snap Gun. It is the smallest of the stores which makes getting in and out while triggering the alarm much quicker. In this jewelry store the safe is in the back small office. You can also interact with the security box to the left of the safe to Destroy Video footage, which prevents police from having your description if you escape the area before they arrive. Interact with the safe and enter the code **1680** to open it. Loot every inside to obtain the buffalo skull chain that Yasmani is requesting. You can also smash the display cases in the store to grab more jewelry to sell. ## Hit Richardson Jewelry “Yasmani is after a diamond ring that’s stored in a safe here.” This jewelry store has a back door which you can open with the Snap Gun, allowing you to enter the back room without alerting security in the front of the store. You can Disarm Security with the panel to the right of the door leading to the center room. You can Destroy Foot on the box under the security screen in the central room. The safe is in the northeast corner of the central room. Enter the code **6815** to open the safe and loot the items inside. If you came in quietly you choose to leave right now to avoid alerting anyone, but if you would rather steal more for extra money you can go through the door to the front of the store and steal the items out of the cases. ## Hit Donovan Banks & Co. “Yasmani is after an amethyst necklace that’s stored in a safe here.” This jewelry store has a back door which you can open with the Snap Gun, allowing you to enter the back room without alerting security in the front of the store. You can Destroy Footage and Disarm Security in the small office in the back. The safe is in the middle of the long hallway room in the back. Enter code **0104** to open the safe and loot the items inside. If you came in quietly you choose to leave right now to avoid alerting anyone, but if you would rather steal more for extra money you can go through the door to the front of the store and steal the items out of the cases. After you have looted all items from all locations return to Yasmani at his store to sell the items and complete the mission. This finishes Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs in GTA VI.
